title: Titan X Sour Apple Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: The Titan X Refill Kit in Sour Apple is designed for use with the Titan X Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. This easy-to-use refill pack contains a 2ml prefilled mouthpiece pod and three 5ml flavour-matched auto-refill capsules, offering a clean, consistent vape without messy refilling. Just click the pod and capsules into place on your Titan X device and you’re ready to go. Sour Apple delivers a sharp, tangy burst of Green Apple flavour, offering a crisp, mouth-watering tartness that softens into a subtly sweet finish. Refreshing and dynamic, this flavour is balanced by a smooth nicotine salt formulation for a comfortable mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape and rapid nicotine relief. Fitted with a pre-installed mesh coil for excellent flavour and vapour production, the Titan X Refill Kit works seamlessly with the Titan X’s auto-refill system, delivering up to approximately 10,000 puffs per refill cycle (usage-dependent).
